intent.proves: At least one page has a publication period that starts in the future or ends before the default end date.

bindings.reason: search_pages rows do not expose the publication period; a page read per id is required.

bindings.query: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Page WHERE PageDeleted = 0 AND (PageActiveFrom > GETDATE() OR PageActiveTo < CONVERT(datetime, '29990101', 112))
